newsitem.title: UK: Wm Morrison gains after profits boost.
newsitem.headline: Wm Morrison gains after profits boost.

text.p: Shares in food retailer Wm. Morrison Supermarkets Plc were indicated higher on Thursday after annual profits of 135.8 million stg topped analysts expectations.
The shares were up 4-1/2p to 151-1/2p by 0825 GMT.
Analysts had been expecting profits of between 128-134 million stg.

Superstore sales rose 7.5 percent on a 52 week basis whilst like-for-like sales were 2.4 percent ahead. Petrol sales meanwhile, fell 10 percent on a like-for-like basis in the face of growing competition.

The company said current sales are showing growth of 1.6 percent excluding petrol, in spite of the fact that in many commodity areas prices are much below last year's level. Trading conditions were expected to remain tough.
Shares in Wm Morrison have fallen more than ten percent from 163p at the beginning of this year.
"It has been an underperformer and people will be a bit more relaxed about it now," said one dealer.
